description: Verify that Field setter — Request payload sets value, Response payload echoes set value
approach:
[Objective]
Field setter — Request payload sets value, Response payload echoes set value.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT offers service; tester sends a Method Request (or specific stimulus); the resulting wire response is verified against the spec property.

[Pass condition]
Response / behaviour matches the asserted property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT setter echoed set value — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_payload_mismatch: Setter Response payload did not echo set value
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response: No setter Response within listen window
